title: Slack app untagged thread follow-up decision pipeline (webhook gates then workflow)
answers: When does the Slack app respond to an untagged thread reply?
What order do gates run for Slack thread follow-ups?
What happens for ask vs auto vs never follow-up mode?
body:
Webhook (products/slack_app/backend/api.py, event routing ~L2200+): DMs (channel_type==im) -> `_route_assistant_event`; `app_mention` always starts a run; channel `message` events are untagged follow-ups.
Drops: `_app_mention_ignore_reason` (edit, bot/app authored via `_app_authorship_ignore_reason`, `_every_mention_is_a_path_segment`); `_thread_message_ignore_reason` (no user/text, edits, subtypes except file_share); `_is_top_level_channel_post`.
Follow-up gate order: region gate `resolve_region_or_terminal_route` -> `discussion_replies.try_ingest_discussion_reply` -> `_resolve_untagged_followup_mapping` (needs SlackThreadTaskMapping) -> `_message_tags_bot` (app_mention copy owns tagged replies) -> `resolve_user_for_workspace` (services/integration_resolver.py) -> mapping integration must be in resolution.candidates (`no_access_to_thread_team`) -> `slack.missing_scopes(REQUIRED_SLACK_SCOPES)` -> `_channel_is_approved` (ext-shared only) -> `_untagged_followups_switched_off` -> `_start_mention_workflow(untagged_followup=True)`.
Missing scopes/unapproved channel/unresolved user notify for mentions but are silent for follow-ups.
Workflow (posthog/temporal/ai/slack_app/posthog_code_slack_mention.py `PostHogCodeSlackMentionWorkflow.run`): billing quota -> `classify_untagged_followup_activity` (find_addressed_bot_user_id drops replies to other apps; `classify_message_is_agent_directed`, default deny, skipped when confirmed or file-only) -> `request_untagged_followup_confirmation_activity` (ask: ephemeral Run/Dismiss via `_post_untagged_followup_prompt`; auto: returns False) -> `forward_posthog_code_followup_activity`.
Run button: `_handle_untagged_followup_run` sets untagged_followup_confirmed=True (skips classifier+prompt) and re-checks `_is_org_member`/`_can_access_team`.
